{"claim_id": "c1", "code": "import torch, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_133")
import kernel

# Exhaustive sweep of ALL finite FP16 values with |x| >= 1024 (both signs), capped at 131072 per call
bits = torch.arange(0, 65536, dtype=torch.int32)
all16 = torch.tensor([torch.float16], device="cpu")  # placeholder
vals = (torch.arange(0, 65536, dtype=torch.int32).view(torch.uint16).view(torch.float16))
vals = vals[torch.isfinite(vals)]
big = vals[vals.abs() >= 1024.0].to(torch.float64)
n = big.numel()
print("total large values:", n, file=sys.stderr)
res = {"tolerance": 1e-6}
allviol = []
maxerr = 0.0
CH = 131072
for i in range(0, n, CH):
    chunk = big[i:i+CH].to("cuda").to(torch.float16)
    out = kernel.run(chunk)
    ref = torch.sin(chunk.to(torch.float64))
    err = (out.to(torch.float64) - ref).abs()
    maxerr = max(maxerr, float(err.max().item()))
    vi = torch.nonzero(err > 1e-6).flatten()
    for j in vi.tolist():
        allviol.append({"x": float(chunk[j].item()), "err": float(err[j].item()),
                        "actual": float(out[j].item()), "ref": float(ref[j].item())})
res["n_tested"] = int(n)
res["n_violations"] = len(allviol)
res["max_err"] = maxerr
res["examples"] = allviol[:15]
print(json.dumps(res))
", "expected_signal": "count of absolute-error >1e-6 violations over all large-|x| FP16 values"}
